programme.title: South Park: När det träffar fläkten
programme.desc: Det blir uppror i South Park när invånarna hör ordet '****' i det populära programmet 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Julesnö
programme.desc: Jultomten stjäl all glädje från stadens julhelg.

programme.title: South Park: God jul, Charlie Manson!
programme.desc: Farbror Howard rymmer från fängelset tillsammans med en annan intern, Charlie Manson. Charlie är redo att njuta av sin frihet men blir distraherad av ett specialinspelat julprogram.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium är inte gratis
programme.desc: Stan blir beroende av ett nytt mobilspel med Terrance och Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: De 99 % gaddar ihop sig mot Eric Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Brösta' canceravsnittet nånsin
programme.desc: Cartmans rykte står på spel när han drar sig för att slåss mot Wendy som är ursinnig för att han skämtat om bröstcancer.

programme.title: South Park: Nåt du kan göra med fingret
programme.desc: 'Fingerbang' är det senaste pojkbandet med de fyra pojkarna och de får en spelning i ett stort shoppingcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Ouppfyllda
programme.desc: Amazon väljer att placera sitt senaste logistikcenter i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Två män nakna i bubbelpool (Del 2)
programme.desc: När pojkarna tjuvringer till polisen omringar de huset på ett sätt som påminner om Waco.

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Laden har pruttkallingar
programme.desc: Efter att de av misstag skickats till Afghanistan tar sig pojkarn an Osama och talibanerna. Där får de lära sig att de har mer gemensamt med de afghanska barnen än de någonsin trott.

programme.title: South Park: Dum och fattig
programme.desc: Cartman drömmer om att bli NASCAR-förare och gör vad som än krävs för att den drömmen ska bli sann.

programme.title: South Park: Skitkul utflykt
programme.desc: När killarna åker på ett studiebesök till en 1800-talsstad, tvingar Cartman Butters att smita och gå på spelhallen bredvid.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: När Wall-Mart omvandlar South Park till en spökstad försöker Stan och Kyle förstöra affären, men en besatt Cartman ställer sig i vägen.

programme.title: South Park: Fetröv och pannkakshuvud
programme.desc: Cartman gör en fingerdocka som liknar J-Lo inför ett multikulturellt evenemang som hyllar latinamerikaner.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha ett världsrekord
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie vill slå världsrekordet för den längsta webbsändningen. För att lyckas med det måste iCarly pågå i över 24 timmar.

programme.title: iCarly: En dejt med Freddie
programme.desc: Efter en bra dejt med iCarly fanet Valerie börjar Freddie filma Valeries egna webshow och slits sedan mellan de två webshowerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Älskar konst
programme.desc: När Spencers favoritkonstnär kallar hans konst dålig känner Spencer att hans liv har förlorat sin mening.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag är ditt största fan
programme.desc: iCarlys största fan visar sig vara en jobbig stalker och gänget försöker bli av med henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Nykläckta ägg
programme.desc: Carly och Sam försöker få kycklingar att kläckas till ett naturkunskaps-projekt. Kycklingarna kläcks tidigare än väntat och rymmer från sin inkubator. Nu måste Carly, Sam, Freddie och Spencer leta efter kycklingar i hela lägenheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill inte bråka
programme.desc: Carly tillverkar en unik iCarly-T-shirt till Sam för att fira årsdagen av då de blev vänner. Men när Sam byter T-shirten mot konsertbiljetter, hamnar de två vännerna i bråk.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansdrömmar
programme.desc: iCarly ber sina fans skicka in filmer av sig själva där de dansar sina coolaste danser. När över tretusen filmklipp kommer in, försöker Carly, Sam och Freddie sitta uppe hela natten för att se på alla filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Läskigt på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie sänder iCarly från en våning som det ryktas att det spökar i. När läskiga saker börjar hända, blir vännerna rädda att spök-ryktena verkligen är sanna.

programme.title: iCarly: Ångra dagen
programme.desc: Spencer räddar livet på sångaren i The Plain White T's och får honom att gå med på att vara med i iCarly. Underliga saker börjar gå fel mitt i Carlys, Sams och Freddies webbsändning.

programme.title: iCarly: Kvarsittning
programme.desc: Sam får kvarsittning samma kväll som det är iCarlys spektakulära, femtionde webbshow. Eftersom de inte kan göra sin planerade webbshow, gör Carly och Freddie sitt bästa för att också få kvarsittning, så att de kan göra showen på kvarsittningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie blir inbjudna till Dakas huvudkontor, där de blir erbjudna en stor summa pengar för att rekommendera Dakas nya sko, Tech-Foot, på iCarly. Men skon visar sig vara fruktansvärd.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag lovar att inte berätta
programme.desc: Carly får betyget B på en historieuppsats hon borde ha fått ett A på. Sam ser sin chans under sitt veckomöte med rektor Franklin, och ändrar Carlys betyg i datorn och överraskar henne med flera A.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV
programme.desc: En höjdar-producent vill förvandla iCarly till en TV-show. Men Carly, Sam och Freddie blir snabbt upprörda när de får höra talas om alla de stora ändringar som TV-producenten vill göra.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Great Meatballs of Fire
programme.desc: Mike försöker vänja sig vid att ha ett förhållande, men har svårt att hålla sig till reglerna. Deena återgår till sitt köttbulleliv, men hon måste kämpa för sin rätt att festa.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Control the Crazy
programme.desc: Sammi konfronterar Deena om hennes köttbullestrul och det slutar med att de går 12 ronder. Mike och resten av gänget får känna på Paulas 'vilda' sida och Mike vet inte om han står ut med det.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Make it Unofficial
programme.desc: Jenni planerar en Shorebabyfest för Nicole och bjuder in alla de andra rumskompisarna. Killarna stöder Mikes beslut att dumpa Paula och följer med för att se hur det hela spelas ut.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber är rädd att hon har utvecklat ett matberoende och kontaktar en läkare, Farrah öppnar en yogurtglassbar, och Tyler är orolig för att Catelynn faller tillbaka i gamla mönster.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber och Gary är redo för Leahs första skoldag, och Catelynn fortsätter brottas med ångest och depression.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber och Matt försöker få stopp på ryktena och får besök av Matts strulige son, Farrah har personalproblem på FroCo, och Tyler och Catelynn firar Butchs första år i frihet.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber och Matt erbjuder Matts son att bo hos dem för att hålla honom nykter, Farrah hälsar på Dereks familj men måste snabbt åka hem igen, och Catelynn och Tyler firar ett år som gifta men är rädda att de inte får träffa Carly.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: My Birthday Romance
programme.desc: Callie Fitzgerald is tired of her family fixing her up and questioning her single status. She is determined to find a pretend boyfriend for her 35th birthday party just so her family will leave her alone. What she didn’t expect was to actually fall for him.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. With a little nudging from the matchmaking daughter, Sophie and Michael unexpectedly start to fall in love and Sophie must decide between returning home or following her heart.

programme.title: A Country Romance
programme.desc: When Sarah Kress learns her family’s vineyard is up for sale, she leaves her busy urban life and visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of handsome neighbor Gabe, huge challenge becomes fun as she and Gabe fall in love. But when the job is done, Sarah must decide whether to return to her fast-paced life or follow her heart.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: The Burning Plain
programme.desc: En mor och dotter försöker bygga upp en relation efter den unga kvinnans svåra barndom.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i den amerikanska småstadshålan Endora tillsammans med sin familj. Han tyngs av vetskapen att han aldrig lär komma från hemstaden, samtidigt som han känner ansvaret för sin utvecklingsstörde lillebror Arnie och sin abnormt överviktiga mamma. Men en dag kommer strandsatta Becky (Juliette Lewis) till staden, och hon får Gilbert att tänka på ett och annat.

programme.title: Wild Mouse
programme.desc: Den berömde musikkritikern Georg (Josef Hader) får börja vända på pengarna när hans chefredaktör (Jörg Hartmann) plötsligt avskedar honom från tidningen i Wien som han har skrivit åt i flera decennier.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor som jobbat för NASA inser att en destruktiv asteroid är på kollisionskurs med jorden och måste få sin familj i säkerhet samtidigt som han varnar världen för denna hotande förödelse.

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt
programme.desc: Den otippade hjälten Bek ger sig ut på en spännande resa för att rädda världen och sin älskade.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: I ett skuggigt rike av företagsspionage, snubblar en uttråkad alla in i ett nät av bedrägeri och blir en omedveten spion. När han navigerar i förräderi och svek, samarbetar han med en förförisk gåta för att avslöja chockerande sanningar och återta sin identitet.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Michael är en skicklig hasardspelare och har sju dagar på sig att betala tillbaka en stor summa pengar till ett gangsterföretag - eller dö. Han samlar ett team specialister med övernaturliga krafter för att vinna stort på ett kasino.

programme.title: Triple Dare
programme.desc: Rebekka, Claudia och Sofie är 15 år. Trots att de är konfirmerade så känner de varje dag att de befinner sig i gränslandet mellan att vara barn och att vara vuxen.

programme.title: Tatjana
programme.desc: Valto och Reino ger sig av på bilfärd och längs vägen plockar de upp Tatjana och Klaudia. Resan går genom ett Finland som inte påverkats av Nokia eller EU utan förblivit urfinskt. Sin vana trogen levererar Kaurismäki en film utan onödig dialog.

programme.title: Pearls And Pigs
programme.desc: Hirvonen och hans fyra söners illegala spritaffär leder till att fadern hamnar i fängelse och att sönerna måste klara sig på egen hand i den gudsförgätna byhålan Joensuu.

programme.title: Dröm vidare
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) måste hitta sin plats i världen efter att ha avtjänat ett fängelsestraff. När hon anställs som hotellstäderska börjar hon leva ett dubbelliv. Hon slits mellan sin sjuka mamma och de gamla vännerna som var som en familj.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: I den omtalade och kritikerhyllade svarta komedin BIRDMAN eller The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance ser vi Michael Keaton i huvudrollen som en skådespelare, mest känd för att ha spelat den ikoniska superhjälten Birdman.

programme.title: A Late Quartet
programme.desc: När den älskade cellisten i en världsberömd stråkkvartett får Parkinsons sjukdom hänger gruppens framtid plötsligt på en skör tråd. Undertryckta känslor, starka egon och passioner hotar deras vänskap och samarbete.

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Stet, en orolig och arg 11-årig föräldralös son från en liten stad i Texas, hamnar på en pojkkörskola i östra Texas efter sin ensamstående mammas död.

programme.title: Alvin och gänget 3
programme.desc: Gänget är på semester och förvandlar ett lyxigt kryssningsfartyg till en enda stor lekplats, men det hela tar en oväntad vändning när de blir skeppsbrutna och hamnar på en öde ö.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: 16-åriga Alice har alltid varit en god katolik. Men när en oskyldig chatt plötsligt blir vågad upptäcker hon onanin och överväldigas av skuldkänslor.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: En blivande modedesigner kämpar för att hitta framgång och kärlek. Berättelsen skär igenom hennes liv en gång om året, alltid på samma datum: hennes födelsedag.

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years Of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian har ett efternamn som är svårt att uttala, hans fantasi är rent episk och så har han en smula svårt för auktoriteter. Han är mer engagerad grabb än rebellisk anarkist och är nu på väg till sin senaste första skoldag på sin tredje högstadieskola.

programme.title: Skuggor i paradiset
programme.desc: Nikander är en ensam sopbils-chaufför som en dag möter den anspråkslösa snabbköpskassörskan Ilona. Nikander blir blixtrande kär, men deras ömsesidiga blyghet medför att det romantiska lyser med sin frånvaro.

programme.title: Midnight Sun
programme.desc: Katie har levt hela sitt 17-åriga liv isolerad i sitt hem. Hon har en sjukdom som gör att hon kan dö om hon utsätts för solljus. Därför måste hon på dagarna hålla sig inomhus och då träffar hon bara sin pappa och sin bästa kompis.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Den en gång i tiden lovande unga kocken, Charlie är nu en omotiverad tjugoåring som bor hemma hos sin mamma och styvpappa medan han arbetar på en biograf och lever genom sin vän, Ben. Hans liv tar en oväntad vändning när han faller för baristan Amber.

programme.title: That Awkward Moment
programme.desc: Vad kan vara bättre än att vara singel i New York? Zac Efron, Miles Teller och Michael B. Jordan har slutit en pakt om att undvika flickvänner till varje pris. Men då de alla tre börjar dejta i smyg, inleds också en omöjlig hinderlöpning för att inte bli upptäckt.

programme.title: Catfish-julen
programme.desc: En hjärtekrossad ung kvinna känner pressen att dejta igen. Hennes syster ordnar en nätdejt med hennes drömman, en proffsidrottare. Men allt är inte som det verkar. Äkta kärlek kan finnas närmare hemmet.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's a Madea Christmas
programme.desc: Madea sprider sin alldeles egen unika julstämning när hon blir övertalad att spendera julen ute på landet med en vän och hennes familj.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: Den här deckaren baseras på boken av den bästsäljande mysterieförfattaren Mary Higgins Clark. En kvinnlig detektiv slår sig samman med en amatördetektiv för att hitta sin försvunna pappa.

programme.title: Jul med en Krona
programme.desc: Det slår gnistor när en stilig främling hjälper till- att organisera familjens årliga julfestival. Men han är egentligen en förklädd prins- och det krävs ett kungligt mirakel för att deras hjärtan ska mötas.

programme.title: Jul på beställning
programme.desc: Gretchen får julen att hända var som helst och när som helst.

programme.title: Christmas at the Greenbrier
programme.desc: A retired pro athlete reunites with his former flame at a luxury resort, rekindling their holiday romance.

programme.title: Golden Christmas
programme.desc: A special dog reunites childhood sweethearts as they battle over buying the same house for Christmas.

programme.title: Seeking a friend at the end of the world
programme.desc: Asteroiden ”Mathilda” er på kollisjonskurs med jorden og er varslet å treffe innen de neste 3 ukene. Forsikringsagenten Dodge Peterson hadde en kone som flyktet i panikk, så for å korte ned ventetiden, bestemmer han seg for å sette seg i bilen for å treffe igjen sin ungdomsforelskelse fra skoledagene.

programme.title: No Good Deed
programme.desc: Jack Friar (Samuel L. Jackson) er en erfaren politimann som vanligvis oppfatter farene på mils avstand. Men denne gang svikter intuisjonen hans da han intetanende havner midt i et banktyveri og blir tatt som gissel. Mens banden høylydt krangler om Jacks skjebne, bevoktes han av lederen Tyrones vakre kjæreste, Erin (Milla Jovovich). De to etterlates alene. Erin vet hvordan hun skal manipulere menn og snart begynner hun et spill der Jack er brikken…

programme.title: Fire With Fire
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt vitne til det brutale mordet på en kioskeier og hans sønn, klarer brannmannen Jeremy Coleman (Duhamel) så vidt å flykte med livet i behold. Som et sentralt øyenvitne må han nå vitne i rettsaken til en høytstående kriminell, og blir deretter plassert i et vitnebeskyttelsesprogram ledet av en U.S. Marshal. Men da hans nye identitet blir røpet, blir det brennhet rundt Jeremy og han står ovenfor de mest nervepirrende timene i sitt liv.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Mestertyven Will Montgomery (Nicolas Cage) blir løslatt etter å ha sittet fengslet i 10 år for et spektakulært innbrudd med et ransutbytte på $ 10 millioner. Han oppsøker sin tenåringsdatter som han ikke har sett på mange år, men når en antatt død medsammensvoren kidnapper datteren og krever det samme beløpet som ransutbyttet i løsepenger, settes Will i en umulig posisjon. Han har bare 12 timer på seg og er konstant overvåket av politiet. Det blir en nervepirrende kamp mot klokka i et voldsomt non-stop action tempo.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels

The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

Thailand in the depths of monsoon season? Sounds like the perfect opportunity for Abbey to tear through three books and avoid talking to Pete at all costs… In our weekly whine (or shine) club, we hear from a couple who have had the picture perfect proposal in nowhere else than the big apple itself as well as a woman who is convinced her husband has taken up whistling as a full time hobby just to drive her round the bend. programme.title: Wedding Planning
programme.desc: On today’s episode, we get an exclusive invite to the planning behind the wedding of the decade. From pre-match nerves to Elton John’s florist - learn more about the planning of the most important day of Abbey’s life (and probably Pete’s as well). We also hear how Abbey feels how she has made a load of new friends since starting the podcast and why Peter is still struggling to show his face in the bakery after THAT famous incident. And your favourite Agony Ab is back, helping to navigate the tricky waters of what to do when your girlfriend plans, and pays for, your wedding without your knowledge but on your credit card and how to get out of your sister’s OTT wedding prep.

programme.title: To Dream The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: In this week’s Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter take a while to sit down and discuss some of their dreams and aspirations both as a pair of youngsters and now as one of the UK’s most prominent power couples. We hear about Abbey’s early days in Genie Queen - Liverpool’s answer to the Sugababes - and a young football protege with dreams of scoring 100 premier league goals and becoming the nation’s Podfather in the process. We also hear from our lovely listeners with their Weekly Whines and Agony Abs. We hear about one of listeners whose girlfriend has being using their toothbrush for bit of DIY and a fellow NETTO alumni has been in touch with a playground anthem that has been sung for generations across Merseyside. Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather

On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch’s Christmas Party!!!

And fear not, we are not abandoning you guys with your own relationship woes, Agony Ab is still on the couch to help with your long distance heart ache and those of you who are struggling with husbands who have little to no interest in putting the Christmas tree up!! Bah humbug! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch

We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia

She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Gen Z Watch Little Britain, Fat Families & Jeremy Kyle For The First Time
programme.desc: Gen Z watches Little Britain, Fat Families, and The Jeremy Kyle Show for the first time and gives their honest reactions to some of the most unhinged British television ever made. From outrageous sketches to brutal reality TV moments, they explore whether it was funny, uncomfortable, or both.

programme.title: Chris Pratt Takes On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Pratt takes on the ultimate British test as he attempts some of the UK's most iconic accents. From London to the North, see how well he really knows British voices and culture.

programme.title: Chris O’Dowd Plays Time Capsule
programme.desc: Chris O'Dowd becomes the first guest to take on the brand new Time Capsule format, building a personal capsule with items connected to his life, career, childhood and biggest memories. He discusses Bridesmaids sequel talk and possible MCU ambitions, the Dublin versus London debate, and shares stories and nostalgic moments throughout.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Average Joe
programme.desc: Average Joe speaks with workers from the Galway Rape Crisis Centre about their free services. They discuss the importance of listening and believing survivors of sexual violence, the role of art therapy in supporting trauma processing, and why you don't need the right words or a label to reach out for help. t.

programme.title: Will Arnett & John Bishop Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Hollywood star Will Arnett and British comedian John Bishop take on the ultimate British Test. From debating if British people are polite to sampling classic British food, tea etiquette, and slang — this duo delivers laughs, charm, and plenty of friendly rivalry. Who's the real British expert? Watch Will Arnett and John Bishop take on the challenge and find out.

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians - Hélène Landemore Interview
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Who Broke Britain's Energy System?
programme.desc: Arthur Downing, an energy expert, discusses his book Power and the People, which charts the history of British energy and how the system became broken.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the “sub-second” reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 “Little Bird” helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at “the sharp end of the spear.” A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - eldon episode 229
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Nerd Connection episode 230
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university’s rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Touched episode 231
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MONNI episode 232
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: I Dream of Neo Tritan episode 9
programme.desc: With the Dalloway gang’s robots wreaking havoc throughout Daedo City, the boys are eager to get X, Y, and Z’s new integration firmware uploaded, but Franklin and Limo have been recruited by the Space Program to help build a base on the moon. The Rescue Crew decide to reveal their creator’s identity, but little do they know that the mysterious Dr. Zinc is already collaborating with Limo and Franklin on the lunar mission. With all the experts too busy to upload the new firmware, Ryan decides to take matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie encounter Eugene’s latest invention – an android lookalike – and Boss Karr hatches a plot to infiltrate the moon program.

programme.title: Moonshots and Masquerades episode 10
programme.desc: The gang settle into Project Whitesail HQ, where the Rescue Crew have an awkward reunion with Maggie (Dr. Zinc), unaware she’s been replaced by team Dalloway’s doppelganger. Franklin and Limo get to work, and the boys explore their new base of operations. After hearing an inspiring anecdote from the project director, Ryan decides to start beta-testing the updated Tritanware. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie attack downtown Daedo City, hoping to distract the Tobots from their presence at Whitesail HQ, and it’s up to Kaylee, Chuck, and Ben to stop them. M, P, and L arrive on the scene, but Boss Karr’s latest battle bot has a secret weapon that prevents them from forming Rescue 3.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Grapes of Wrath
programme.desc: A report about the 2015 showdown between two millionaires, Robert Dahl and Emad Tawfilis, whose bitter money dispute over a Napa Valley winery business ended in murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Mystery at Eagle Creek
programme.desc: A report on the 2009 death of Rhonda Casto, who went hiking in Oregon’s Columbia River Gorge with her boyfriend, Stephen Nichols, and she never returned home.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Who Killed Fabio
programme.desc: The 2017 murder of famed hairstylist Fabio Sementilli who was found stabbed to death by his pool in Los Angeles. At first, police believed he was the victim of the “knock-knock” burglars, a ring targeting Hollywood celebrities.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Killer Performance
programme.desc: The 2010 murder investigation of 23-year-old dancer Julie Kibuishi in Southern California, and how her friend Sam Herr, became the prime suspect in the case until investigators encountered an aspiring actor with a horrific tale to tell.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Last Ride Home
programme.desc: An examination of the 2016 case of wealthy lawyer Tex McIver, who shot his wife Diane McIver from the backseat of a car while their friend drove them home.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: A report on the investigation into the 1960 murder of Irena Garza, in McAllen, Texas, and the efforts that family members and police have taken to bring the suspect, a Roman Catholic priest, to trial for the crime.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in Pinyon Pines
programme.desc: A report on the investigation into the triple murders and the long quest for justice for Vicki Friedli, her boyfriend Jon Hayward, and Vicki's daughter Becky Friedli.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Accidental Husband
programme.desc: A report on Harold Henthorn, a twice-widowed man from Colorado whose two wives both died in unusual accidents, and whose changing account of events led family members to suspect that he murdered them.

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A small town hair dresser is found beaten and strangled in her beauty salon. After the investigation goes cold, an act of conscience cracks the case.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hidden Clue
programme.desc: A hidden clue may hold the key to solving the vicious murder of a young woman.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Lies
programme.desc: After a college student is found stabbed to death in her off-campus apartment, it may take a second murder to solve her case.

programme.title: On the Case: Identical Evidence
programme.desc: Police discover a treasure trove of evidence after teacher Genai Coleman is found murdered in a parking lot, but detectives still face a challenge that may prevent the case from being solved.

programme.title: On the Case: Silenced
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman goes missing, police are baffled.
